_about: Battle Brothers body armour, headgear and shields copied exactly from the wiki text in the repo (rule 63d); every row cites its page. Rows = the Body Armor, Headgear and Shields list pages (transcluded by # PAGE Armor in CORE_WIKITEXT.md); the item's own page infobox fills blanks and any disagreement is kept in conflicts. fatigue = Max. Fatigue penalty as the wiki shows it (negative). A blank Max. Fatigue cell on cloth items is left null (the wiki prints nothing). vision on headgear = the Vision column (negative). Named, legendary and unique items are left out (see _excluded); the crafted Lindwurm, Living Tree and Kraken shields are standard list rows and are kept. Shield skills come from each shield page's Skills section, looked up on the skill pages. Shield list notes: Buckler 'Shieldwall skill is unavailable'; skirmisher shields 'Knock Back skill is unavailable'; Heavy Metal Shield 'Shield skills build up additional 5 Fatigue for humans'.

skills.name: Knock Back
skills.effect: Knocks a hostile target one tile away (except for when it is rooted, immune, or blocked from behind and sides). The knocked back target will receive Fatigue damage and also HP damage, if it is pushed down several levels of height. Removes Shieldwall, Spearwall and Riposte. Gains +15% chance to hit if you have Shield Expert perk.
